text: You ordered online. The item arrived broken.
Can a seller just say no refunds?
In India, e-commerce rules protect buyers when goods are defective or not as described.
A no-refunds label does not erase those obligations.
Changing your mind is a different situation; there is no automatic right to return every purchase.
Keep the invoice, photograph the problem, and request a refund in writing.
